## A familiar face by the sea

Look for a pale grey back, white underparts and black wing tips with white markings. Adults have pink legs. Young birds look quite different, so age matters when comparing plumage.

### Look a little closer

- Compare the bird with nearby gulls.
- Notice the back colour and leg colour.
- Watch for the white markings when it opens its wings.

### In your notebook

Record the place, date and the features you could actually see. Leave uncertain details as questions.

Source: [RSPB Herring Gull guide](https://www.rspb.org.uk/birds-and-wildlife/herring-gull).
